subject.title: Register managed SKUs at logical zero

question: Should existing version-2 Durable Object storage be supported through an in-place migration before this schema-v3 feature is released?
rationale: The branch intentionally rejects the currently supported v2 persistent shape, and only a maintainer can decide whether that deployed or previously initialized state may be declared unsupported.

options.title: Require a v2-to-v3 migration
options.body: Preserve existing Durable Object data and add upgrade proof before merging.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep this branch out of release until the repository can guarantee no v2 storage needs compatibility.

recommendation.title: Require a v2-to-v3 migration
recommendation.body: Preserve existing Durable Object data and add upgrade proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The provided approval record places the managed-SKU scope and deployment boundary with Bobby.
